business_problem: The lack of a centralized, readily accessible knowledge base often leads to reduced machine productivity, prolonged machine downtime, and higher troubleshooting and repair costs. Making phone calls to experts and searching through binders, manuals, and maintenance records takes time and increases the risk of downtime.
solution_summary: For nearly a century, Georgia-Pacific has been a major player in the manufacturing of paper products, packaging, and lumber. As a large-scale manufacturing operation, the company remains competitive by performing routine maintenance, optimizing manufacturing lines, and minimizing equipment downtime. The company also uses Amazon Kinesis , a fully managed service that cost-effectively processes and analyzes streaming data at scale. Learn how Georgia-Pacific, a leading manufacturer, is transforming knowledge management using Amazon Bedrock. Georgia-Pacific engaged with AWS Professional Services , a global team of experts that helps companies realize their desired business outcomes on AWS. Through Amazon Bedrock, Georgia-Pacific adopted Anthropic’s Claude, a large language model, to help the chatbot understand and respond to user queries with high accuracy and context.
